caption:
And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

Surah Hud (11:115). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."
